You're on the design for the alert toast component, which polls `/api/incident/{incidentId}/status` and transitions to a green "Telemetry pipeline restored" state automatically once the backend returns 200 [source:CONF-ENG-303]. If you were testing or dogfooding this during or after the incident, the resolved state would have been visible directly in the UI.

I couldn't find a record of *who specifically* received the Day 3 stakeholder postmortem distribution, so I can't confirm you were on that list by name. But between #ops-announcements and your own workstream touching the incident status endpoint, Day 28 is comfortably within what normal channels would have delivered.

If you're asking because you suspect there's a gap — e.g., you missed the resolved event and someone's holding you to account — the postmortem is documented in Jira (ENG-148, Engineering_Backend) and Confluence, so you can pull the full record [source:ENG-148].
